voltage_basis: project supply voltage is phase-to-earth U0
loop_route_basis: phase and CPC each follow project one-way route length

sources.scenario: Explicit synthetic TN bolted L-PE loop, hot impedance and minimum-voltage assumptions; common source one-way route for phase/CPC. Not measured, course or regulation values.
sources.device: Synthetic 6 A device: at 230 V, all prospective fault currents 60..6000 A have total clearing time <=0.1 s; standalone breaking capacity 6000 A. Not manufacturer data; no cascading. Voltage applicability is the nominal system rating; the synthetic guarantee includes the declared minimum-voltage loop case and maximum prospective case.
sources.limit: Synthetic 0.4 s required disconnection time for verification fixture only; not a supplied code clause.
sources.cpc: Synthetic 1.5 mm2 CPC, k=115 A sqrt(s)/mm2 and adiabatic applicability up to 5 s. Material/insulation/initial-final temperatures require actual source review.
sources.energy: Synthetic guaranteed maximum complete let-through integral 20000 A2s for all faults 60..6000 A; not prospective current squared times trip time and not manufacturer data.
sources.maximum: Synthetic maximum prospective RMS fault 4000 A at the protective device covering all relevant fault modes; independently supplied from the minimum L-PE loop case.
